methods.title: EchoTime shape similarity
methods.intro_en: EchoTime's shape component combines agreement in standardized levels with agreement in their first differences. Negative correlations are clipped to zero, and a geometric mean requires both views to contribute positively. The animation reproduces these intermediate views and their actual component scores on a 24-point example, making the package-specific blend explicit.
methods.intro_zh: EchoTime 的形状分项结合标准化水平值和一阶差分的一致性。负相关先截为零，几何平均要求两个视角都具有正贡献。动图使用 24 点示例复现各中间表示与真实分项数值，明确展示这个软件特有的组合。
steps_en: Resample and standardize each channel with the same declared point count.
Compute Pearson correlation of aligned levels.
Compute Pearson correlation of standardized first differences.
Clip correlations to [0,1] and take their geometric mean.
steps_zh: 按声明的点数重采样并分别标准化通道。
计算对齐水平值的 Pearson 相关。
计算标准化一阶差分的 Pearson 相关。
将相关截至 [0,1] 后取几何平均。
caveats_en: Clipping makes anticorrelation and zero correlation equally contribute zero.
This is a package-specific similarity component, not a calibrated probability.
The 24-point demonstration changes resolution from the default 256-point pipeline.
caveats_zh: 截断使负相关和零相关都贡献零。
这是软件特定的相似性分项，不是校准概率。
24 点演示采用的分辨率与默认 256 点流程不同。

methods.title: EchoTime DTW similarity
methods.intro_en: The native DTW component runs constrained alignments on both standardized levels and standardized first differences. Each local cost is an absolute gap; the accumulated path cost is divided by the sum of sequence lengths. Two different exponential scales convert those costs into scores, whose geometric mean is the reported component. The animation reconstructs both actual dynamic programs.
methods.intro_zh: 原生 DTW 分项对标准化水平值和标准化一阶差分分别执行有约束对齐。局部代价是绝对差，累计路径代价除以两序列长度之和，再通过不同尺度的指数函数转成分数，最终取几何平均。动图重建这两个实际动态规划。
steps_en: Standardize levels and first differences separately.
Accumulate absolute local costs within the level warping band.
Run the same recurrence on differences with their declared band.
Normalize costs by n+m, use scales 0.45 and 0.35, and combine geometrically.
steps_zh: 分别标准化水平值与一阶差分。
在水平值规整窗口内累加绝对局部代价。
对差分按其窗口执行同样递推。
按 n+m 归一化，以 0.45 和 0.35 指数映射后取几何平均。
caveats_en: This native score differs from square-root-of-squared-cost DTW distances in other libraries.
The band, resampling resolution, derivative normalization and scales affect the value.
A high score does not imply causal correspondence or a probability of identity.
caveats_zh: 此原生分数与其他库常用的平方代价开根号 DTW 距离不同。
窗口、重采样分辨率、差分标准化和指数尺度都会影响数值。
高分不表示因果对应或同一性的概率。

methods.title: EchoTime trend similarity
methods.intro_en: The trend component smooths each standardized input with the package's Savitzky-Golay settings. It compares both the smoothed levels and their standardized first differences, then combines clipped correlations geometrically. The animation reveals the fitted trend before comparison. This separates the declared smoothing scale from a claim that the observed signal has one uniquely identifiable trend.
methods.intro_zh: 趋势分项按软件的 Savitzky-Golay 设置平滑各标准化输入，分别比较平滑后的水平值和标准化一阶差分，再对截断相关取几何平均。动画先展示拟合趋势，再比较两侧；所声明的平滑尺度不意味着信号存在唯一可识别的趋势。
steps_en: Apply the declared Savitzky-Golay smoother to both standardized inputs.
Measure correlation between the smooth level curves.
Measure correlation between standardized first differences of those curves.
Clip both correlations and take their geometric mean.
steps_zh: 按所声明参数对两侧标准化输入进行 Savitzky-Golay 平滑。
比较平滑水平曲线的相关。
比较平滑曲线标准化一阶差分的相关。
截断两个相关并取几何平均。
caveats_en: The window is length-dependent, so changing n_points changes the smoothing scale.
Smoothing can conceal short events that still matter for the application.
Endpoint interpolation is part of the displayed Savitzky-Golay convention.
caveats_zh: 窗口随长度变化，改变 n_points 会改变平滑尺度。
平滑可能掩盖应用中重要的短暂事件。
端点插值属于此 Savitzky-Golay 实现约定。

methods.title: EchoTime derivative similarity
methods.intro_en: The derivative component compares local increments after standardizing the input and then standardizing its first differences. It reports the positive part of their Pearson correlation. The animation follows the difference vectors and their normalized product terms, exposing why two signals can share a slow level pattern while differing substantially in their local changes.
methods.intro_zh: 差分分项先标准化输入，再标准化其一阶差分，以两组差分 Pearson 相关的正部分作为相似度。动画追踪差分向量及归一化乘积，说明两条序列即使共享缓慢变化的水平形状，局部变化仍可能不同。
steps_en: Resample and standardize each original series.
Take first differences and standardize those differences separately.
Compute Pearson correlation of the aligned change vectors.
Clip the correlation to [0,1].
steps_zh: 重采样并标准化原序列。
取一阶差分并分别标准化。
计算对齐变化向量的 Pearson 相关。
将相关截至 [0,1]。
caveats_en: Differencing can amplify measurement noise and reduces the sample count by one.
Anticorrelated changes receive zero similarity after clipping.
Sampling resolution determines which changes are treated as local.
caveats_zh: 差分可能放大测量噪声，并使样本数减少一个。
反向相关的变化经截断后获得零相似度。
采样分辨率决定哪些变化被视为局部。

methods.title: EchoTime spectral similarity
methods.intro_en: EchoTime's spectral component works on standardized first differences. It linearly detrends the periodogram input, drops the zero-frequency bin, and normalizes the remaining power. One term measures one minus base-two JS divergence; another measures positive correlation of spectral structure. Their geometric mean produces the actual score shown by the animation.
methods.intro_zh: EchoTime 的频谱分项作用于标准化一阶差分。周期图计算使用线性去趋势，去除零频箱并归一化其余功率。一个分项取 1 减二进制 JS 散度，另一个衡量频谱结构的正相关，动图展示两者几何平均得到的实际分数。
steps_en: Use standardized first differences as spectral input.
Compute linearly detrended periodograms, remove DC and normalize power.
Calculate 1-JS divergence in bits and positive spectral correlation.
Take the geometric mean of overlap and structure scores.
steps_zh: 以标准化一阶差分作为频谱输入。
计算线性去趋势周期图，去除零频并归一化功率。
计算二进制 1−JS 散度与频谱正相关。
对重叠和结构分数取几何平均。
caveats_en: Power spectra discard phase; similar spectra do not ensure aligned waveforms.
The JS term here is a divergence in bits, not the square-root JS distance in another atlas card.
Resampling, differentiation and detrending all change the spectral object being compared.
caveats_zh: 功率谱舍弃相位，频谱相似不保证波形对齐。
这里的 JS 项是以比特为单位的散度，与另一条目的平方根 JS 距离不同。
重采样、差分和去趋势都会改变所比较的频谱对象。

Center the paired observations.
Normalize their product sum by both centered norms.

对配对观测去均值。

methods.title: EchoTime reference: Spearman rho
methods.intro_en: The native Spearman reference converts the report's resampled observations to average ranks and correlates those ranks. It complements amplitude-based comparisons by exposing monotone agreement on the same grid. The animation makes the ranking operation visible, including ties, and retains a signed coefficient; its value depends on the observations created by the chosen interpolation resolution.
methods.intro_zh: 原生 Spearman 参照把报告重采样后的观测转换为平均排名，再计算相关。它在相同网格上展示单调一致性，补充幅值比较。动画显示含并列处理的排名操作并保留符号；结果依赖所选插值分辨率产生的观测。
steps_en: Use the same resampled observations as the native report.
Assign average ranks independently, retaining paired sample identities.
Center ranks and normalize their product sum.
Report the signed rank coefficient.

独立赋予平均排名，保留配对身份。
对排名去均值并归一化乘积。
报告带符号排名系数。
caveats_en: EchoTime assigns zero for constant inputs; statistical correlation is undefined in that case.
These are dependence summaries, not causal tests or identity probabilities.

methods.title: EchoTime reference: Kendall tau-b
methods.intro_en: The native Kendall reference uses tau-b, including corrections for one-sided ties, on the resampled input grid. It counts ordering agreements and disagreements rather than amplitude gaps. The animation reconstructs its pair classifications and normalization. This explanatory enumeration matches the score while leaving the numerical library free to use a more efficient algorithm internally.
methods.intro_zh: 原生 Kendall 参照在重采样网格上使用包含单侧并列校正的 tau-b，统计顺序同向与反向关系，不比较幅值差。动画重建配对分类和归一化；这种教学枚举与实际分数一致，数值库内部可以使用更高效算法。
steps_en: Use the native report's resampled observations.
Compare relative orders for observation pairs.
Count concordance, discordance and one-sided ties.
Apply tau-b normalization and keep its sign.
steps_zh: 使用原生报告重采样后的观测。
比较观测对的相对顺序。
统计同序、逆序和单侧并列。
应用 tau-b 归一化并保留符号。
caveats_en: EchoTime assigns zero for constant inputs; statistical correlation is undefined in that case.
These are dependence summaries, not causal tests or identity probabilities.

methods.title: EchoTime reference: best-lag Pearson
methods.intro_en: The native best-lag reference scans a bounded set of shifts on the report's resampled grid. Pearson correlation is recomputed on each actual overlap, including a separate overlap mean and norm. The animation uses a delayed illustrative series to show the improvement from lag zero to the selected lag while keeping the finite search window explicit.
methods.intro_zh: 原生最佳滞后参照在报告重采样网格上扫描有限平移。每个实际重叠片段重新计算 Pearson 相关，使用各自均值和范数。动画以延迟序列展示零滞后到最佳滞后的变化，并明确有限搜索窗口。
steps_en: Resample both inputs; derive the native maximum lag from n_points.
At every admitted lag, take the actual overlap.
Recompute centered Pearson correlation on each overlap.
Return the maximum signed coefficient and interpret its lag in resampled points.
steps_zh: 重采样两侧输入，按 n_points 得到原生最大滞后。
对每个允许滞后取实际重叠。
在各重叠片段重新计算中心化 Pearson 相关。
返回最大带符号系数，滞后单位为重采样点。
caveats_en: The selected lag is measured on the normalized/resampled axis, not automatically in physical time.
Searching several lags changes the interpretation from a prespecified single correlation.
Overlap-specific centering differs from full-norm normalized cross-correlation.
caveats_zh: 所选滞后以归一化重采样轴为单位，不能自动解释为实际时间。
搜索多个滞后与事先指定单个相关的统计解释不同。
逐重叠去均值与全范数归一化互相关不同。

methods.title: EchoTime reference: normalized mutual information
methods.intro_en: EchoTime estimates mutual information from a joint histogram of aligned, resampled observations. It compares observed joint mass with the product of marginal masses, then divides by the geometric mean of marginal entropies. The animation shows the actual bin counts and information terms. The resulting finite-sample dependence estimate is sensitive to the declared binning rule.
methods.intro_zh: EchoTime 通过对齐且重采样观测的联合直方图估计互信息，比较联合概率与边缘概率乘积，再除以两侧熵的几何平均。动画显示真实箱计数及信息贡献项。有限样本依赖估计对所声明的分箱规则敏感。
steps_en: Use the aligned resampled observations and the native bin-count rule.
Count their joint histogram and normalize it to probability mass.
Compute MI from joint-versus-independent mass and both marginal entropies.
Divide MI by sqrt(Hx*Hy) and clip to [0,1].
steps_zh: 使用对齐的重采样观测和原生分箱数规则。
计算联合直方图并归一化为概率。
由联合质量与独立质量比较得到 MI，同时计算边缘熵。
以 sqrt(Hx*Hy) 归一化 MI 并截至 [0,1]。
caveats_en: Binning and finite sample size introduce estimation bias; a nonzero score is not a significance test.
The native function needs at least twelve finite paired observations and gives constant inputs a zero convention.
Dependence does not establish causality, waveform equality or temporal forecasting ability.
caveats_zh: 分箱和有限样本引入估计偏差；非零分数不是显著性检验。
原生函数要求至少十二对有限观测，并对常量输入约定为零。
依赖关系不证明因果、波形相等或时间预测能力。

methods.title: Euclidean distance
methods.intro_en: Euclidean distance treats an aligned time series as one vector. Every vertical gap contributes a squared cost, and the final square root returns the result to the original amplitude units. The animation shows exactly which sample differences produce the final distance; no temporal realignment is performed.
methods.intro_zh: 欧氏距离把已经对齐的时间序列视为向量。每个时刻的垂直差先平方后累加，再开平方回到原始幅值单位。动图展示各时刻如何贡献最终距离，整个计算不重新对齐时间。
steps_en: Keep the two series on the same sample grid; no shift or warping is estimated.
Square each residual; the highlighted point supplies one coordinate contribution.
Accumulate the coordinate contributions in sample order.
Take the square root of the total squared gap.
steps_zh: 在同一采样网格上比较两条序列，不估计平移或时间规整。
计算各坐标残差的平方。
按采样顺序累积局部贡献。
对平方差总和开平方。
caveats_en: A single large residual can dominate the squared sum.
Sample alignment and amplitude units are part of the comparison protocol.
caveats_zh: 单个大误差可能主导平方和。
采样对齐和幅值单位属于比较协议的一部分。

methods.title: Squared Euclidean
methods.intro_en: Squared Euclidean distance accumulates squared residuals without taking a square root. This makes coordinate contributions additive and keeps large errors prominent. It has the same nearest-neighbour ordering as Euclidean distance on the same vectors, but the output has squared amplitude units and is not a metric.
methods.intro_zh: 平方欧氏距离直接累加平方残差，不再开平方。因此各坐标贡献可相加，大误差受到更强惩罚。在同一组向量上，它与欧氏距离给出相同的近邻排序，但结果单位为幅值平方，也不满足一般的三角不等式。
steps_en: Keep the two series on the same sample grid; no shift or warping is estimated.
Square each residual; the highlighted point supplies one coordinate contribution.
Accumulate the coordinate contributions in sample order.
Keep the squared sum; do not take a square root.
steps_zh: 在同一采样网格上比较两条序列，不估计平移或时间规整。
计算各坐标残差的平方。
按采样顺序累积局部贡献。
直接保留平方差总和，不开平方。
caveats_en: Squaring a metric does not generally preserve the triangle inequality.
Sample alignment and amplitude units are part of the comparison protocol.
caveats_zh: 对度量取平方通常不保留三角不等式。
采样对齐和幅值单位属于比较协议的一部分。

methods.title: Root mean square error
methods.intro_en: RMSE averages squared residuals before taking a square root. For vectors of one fixed length it is Euclidean distance divided by the square root of that length. The animation separates the squared-error accumulation, averaging, and final root so its difference from a raw Euclidean total is visible.
methods.intro_zh: RMSE 先对平方误差取平均，再开平方。向量长度固定时，它等于欧氏距离除以长度的平方根。动图将平方累加、求平均和开平方分开，说明它与未归一化欧氏距离的关系。
steps_en: Keep the two series on the same sample grid; no shift or warping is estimated.
Square each residual; the highlighted point supplies one coordinate contribution.
Accumulate the coordinate contributions in sample order.
Divide by sample count, then take the square root.
steps_zh: 在同一采样网格上比较两条序列，不估计平移或时间规整。
计算各坐标残差的平方。
按采样顺序累积局部贡献。
平方差总和除以样本数后，再开平方。
caveats_en: The fixed-length equivalence does not justify comparing different missing-data or alignment protocols.
Sample alignment and amplitude units are part of the comparison protocol.
caveats_zh: 固定长度下的等价关系不能代替缺失值和对齐协议的一致性。
采样对齐和幅值单位属于比较协议的一部分。

methods.title: Manhattan distance
methods.intro_en: Manhattan distance adds the absolute gap at every aligned time point. Positive and negative errors cannot cancel, and the penalty grows linearly with each residual. Its animation accumulates visible vertical discrepancies one by one. Longer vectors can produce larger totals even when their typical per-sample discrepancy is unchanged.

steps_zh: 保留完整采样向量，不去均值。
计算向量范数和逐坐标乘积。
以范数乘积归一化点积。
应用所示最终变换得到分数。
caveats_en: Zero-norm vectors have no defined angle; this example excludes them.
Positive scaling is removed but an additive offset changes the direction.
The normalized angular form is a metric on unit directions; 1-cosine generally fails the triangle inequality.
caveats_zh: 零范数向量的夹角未定义，本例不包含此情形。
正缩放被消除，但加性偏移会改变方向。

methods.input_label: Deterministic synthetic illustration; sample index is the time axis.
animation_steps_en: Keep the uncentered sample vectors.
Compute coordinate products and both vector norms.
Divide the dot product by the norm product.
Return arccos(cosine) divided by pi.

methods.title: Pearson correlation
methods.intro_en: Pearson correlation measures linear co-variation of aligned observations after centering both vectors. The animation reveals each centered-product contribution and normalizes by the full centered norms. Positive correlation, anticorrelation and weak linear association remain different outcomes; a distance card applies the explicit one-minus transform to the same coefficient.
methods.intro_zh: Pearson 相关衡量对齐观测去均值后的线性协同变化。动图逐项展示中心化乘积，再用完整中心化向量的范数归一化。正相关、负相关和弱线性关系具有不同含义；距离条目显式使用 1 减相关系数。
steps_en: Pair observations at the same sample index.
Subtract the mean from each series independently.
Sum centered products and divide by centered vector norms.
Read the signed agreement coefficient.
steps_zh: 按相同采样位置配对观测。
分别减去各自均值。
累加中心化乘积并按范数归一化。
读取相关系数或其 1 减变换。
caveats_en: Constant inputs have undefined statistical correlation; zero-return conventions are software-specific.
Correlation describes linear dependence, not matching units or causal influence.
1-r is a dissimilarity and generally fails the triangle inequality.
caveats_zh: 常量输入的统计相关未定义；返回零属于软件约定。
相关描述线性依赖，不代表单位相同或因果作用。
1−r 属于差异量，一般不满足三角不等式。
methods.input_label: Deterministic synthetic illustration; sample index is the time axis.
animation_steps_en: Pair observations at the same sample index.
Center each sample vector independently.
Normalize the centered product sum.
Keep the signed Pearson r.

methods.title: Spearman rank correlation
methods.intro_en: Spearman correlation replaces amplitudes by their ranks and then computes Pearson correlation of those ranks. Tied observations receive average ranks in this example. The animation makes this change of representation explicit: a monotone nonlinear amplitude transformation can retain rank agreement even when the raw scatter is not a straight line.
methods.intro_zh: Spearman 相关先把幅值转换成排名，再计算排名的 Pearson 相关。本例对并列值使用平均排名。动图显式展示表示变换：单调非线性幅值变换即使改变原始散点的线性关系，仍可能保留排名一致性。
steps_en: Pair observations and retain their original sample identities.
Replace amplitudes with average ranks, including ties.
Compute Pearson correlation of the two rank vectors.
Read the signed agreement coefficient.
steps_zh: 配对观测并保留原始采样身份。
将幅值替换为含并列处理的平均排名。
计算两组排名的 Pearson 相关。
读取排名相关或其 1 减变换。
caveats_en: Amplitude differences are intentionally discarded by ranking.
A nonmonotone dependence may be strong while Spearman correlation is weak.
The chosen tie rule and missing-value handling belong to the definition.
caveats_zh: 排名主动舍弃幅值差异。
强非单调依赖也可能具有很弱的 Spearman 相关。
并列排名和缺失值处理属于定义的一部分。
methods.input_label: Deterministic synthetic illustration; sample index is the time axis.
animation_steps_en: Pair observations and retain sample identities.
Assign average ranks, including ties.
Compute Pearson correlation of rank vectors.
Keep the signed rank correlation.

methods.title: Spearman distance
methods.intro_en: Spearman correlation replaces amplitudes by their ranks and then computes Pearson correlation of those ranks. Tied observations receive average ranks in this example. The animation makes this change of representation explicit: a monotone nonlinear amplitude transformation can retain rank agreement even when the raw scatter is not a straight line.

Replace amplitudes with average ranks, including ties.
Compute Pearson correlation of the two rank vectors.
Subtract similarity from one.

计算两组排名的 Pearson 相关。

methods.title: Kendall tau-b
methods.intro_en: Kendall tau-b compares the ordering of every pair of aligned observations. Concordant and discordant pairs contribute with opposite signs, while one-sided ties alter the normalization. The animation exposes the pairwise sign matrix and count table. This implementation uses tau-b, so its treatment of ties is not replaced by a no-ties shortcut.
methods.intro_zh: Kendall tau-b 比较每对对齐观测的顺序关系。同序和逆序配对贡献相反符号，单侧并列值改变归一化。动图展示配对符号矩阵与计数表，使用含并列校正的 tau-b，不用无并列情形的简化公式替代。
steps_en: Enumerate unordered observation pairs.
Classify each pair as concordant, discordant or tied.
Count one-sided ties separately; joint ties enter neither tie term.
Apply tau-b normalization, then 1-tau if this is the distance variant.
steps_zh: 枚举无序观测配对。
判断同序、逆序或并列。
分别统计单侧并列；双侧并列不进入单侧并列项。
应用 tau-b 归一化；距离型再取 1−tau。
caveats_en: Ordering does not preserve the magnitude of differences.
A zero normalization denominator leaves tau undefined; the illustration avoids this case.
The animated pair enumeration is educational; optimized software need not enumerate all pairs explicitly.
caveats_zh: 顺序关系不保留差异幅度。
归一化分母为零时 tau 未定义，本例避开此情形。
动画显式枚举配对用于教学；优化软件无需逐对枚举。
methods.input_label: Deterministic synthetic illustration; sample index is the time axis.
animation_steps_en: Enumerate unordered observation pairs.
Classify concordance, discordance and ties.
Count one-sided ties separately.
Apply tie-corrected tau-b normalization.

methods.title: Kendall distance
methods.intro_en: Kendall tau-b compares the ordering of every pair of aligned observations. Concordant and discordant pairs contribute with opposite signs, while one-sided ties alter the normalization. The animation exposes the pairwise sign matrix and count table. This implementation uses tau-b, so its treatment of ties is not replaced by a no-ties shortcut.

Classify each pair as concordant, discordant or tied.

methods.title: Jensen-Shannon distance
methods.intro_en: Jensen-Shannon distance compares two probability vectors through their midpoint distribution. Each side contributes a KL divergence to that midpoint, the two values are averaged, and the square root produces the distance shown here. The animated bins share a fixed support; their positions describe probability mass rather than a time-warping alignment.
methods.intro_zh: Jensen-Shannon 距离以两概率向量的中点分布作为共同参照，平均两侧到中点的 KL 散度，再开平方。本动画使用固定共同支持集；横轴位置表示概率质量所在的箱，而不是时间规整的匹配位置。
steps_en: Declare one shared bin support and normalize nonnegative mass to sum to one.
Compute each bin's two-sided KL-to-midpoint contribution.
Accumulate the displayed bin contributions, retaining any signed terms.
Take the square root of the averaged divergence.
steps_zh: 声明共同箱支持集，将非负质量归一化为概率。
按该方法公式计算逐箱贡献。
累加所示贡献，保留可能出现的符号。
应用所示最后的根号、对数或直接求和。
caveats_en: This card shows the square root, not raw JS divergence.
Logarithm base changes the scale; natural logs are used here.
caveats_zh: 本条目展示平方根形式，并非原始 JS 散度。
对数底改变数值尺度，本例使用自然对数。
methods.input_label: Synthetic counts on eight shared bins; these bins are not timestamps.
animation_steps_en: Normalize counts on one shared bin support.
Compute each bin's two-sided KL-to-midpoint contribution.
Accumulate the displayed bin contributions.
Take the square root of the averaged divergence.

methods.title: Kullback-Leibler divergence
methods.intro_en: KL divergence weights each log probability ratio by the mass of the first distribution. Individual bin contributions can be negative even though the complete divergence is nonnegative. The animation retains those signed contributions and a declared direction p to q. Changing the order of the distributions generally changes the answer.
methods.intro_zh: KL 散度用第一个分布的概率质量加权对数概率比。单箱贡献可以为负，而完整散度非负。动画保留这些带符号贡献，并明确方向为 p 到 q；交换两分布通常改变结果。
steps_en: Declare one shared bin support and normalize nonnegative mass to sum to one.
Weight log(p/q) by p.
Accumulate the displayed bin contributions, retaining any signed terms.
Add signed bin terms in the declared p-to-q direction.
steps_zh: 声明共同箱支持集，将非负质量归一化为概率。
按该方法公式计算逐箱贡献。
累加所示贡献，保留可能出现的符号。
应用所示最后的根号、对数或直接求和。
caveats_en: If p is positive where q is zero, KL is infinite; both vectors here are strictly positive.
KL is asymmetric and does not obey the metric triangle inequality.
caveats_zh: 若 p 在 q 为零处为正，KL 为无穷；本例两侧均严格为正。
KL 不对称，也不满足度量三角不等式。
methods.input_label: Synthetic counts on eight shared bins; these bins are not timestamps.
animation_steps_en: Normalize counts on one shared bin support.
Weight log(p/q) by p.
Accumulate the displayed bin contributions.
Add signed bin terms in the declared p-to-q direction.

methods.title: Jeffreys divergence
methods.intro_en: Jeffreys divergence adds KL divergences in both directions. On strictly positive probabilities the two terms combine into a per-bin product of the probability difference and its log ratio. The animation shows this symmetric contribution directly. Symmetrizing KL removes its directional asymmetry while leaving a divergence whose metric properties need separate analysis.
methods.intro_zh: Jeffreys 散度相加两个方向的 KL 散度。概率严格为正时，可逐箱写成概率差与对数比的乘积。动图直接展示该对称贡献；对称化消除了方向不对称，但不能自动赋予其度量性质。
steps_en: Declare one shared bin support and normalize nonnegative mass to sum to one.
Combine KL terms in both directions.
Accumulate the displayed bin contributions, retaining any signed terms.
Sum the symmetric log-ratio contributions.
steps_zh: 声明共同箱支持集，将非负质量归一化为概率。
按该方法公式计算逐箱贡献。
累加所示贡献，保留可能出现的符号。
应用所示最后的根号、对数或直接求和。
caveats_en: Symmetry alone does not establish a metric.
A support mismatch can make the result infinite; no smoothing is hidden in this illustration.
caveats_zh: 对称性本身不能证明度量性质。
支持集不匹配可能使结果无穷；本例没有隐藏平滑。
methods.input_label: Synthetic counts on eight shared bins; these bins are not timestamps.
animation_steps_en: Normalize counts on one shared bin support.
Combine KL terms in both directions.
Accumulate the displayed bin contributions.
Sum the symmetric log-ratio contributions.

methods.title: Bhattacharyya distance
methods.intro_en: Bhattacharyya distance first adds the geometric-mean overlap of corresponding probability masses. It then applies a negative logarithm, so greater overlap gives a smaller distance. The animation separates the overlap coefficient from the final transformed score. The supplied positive distributions overlap everywhere, making the logarithm finite without a numerical floor.
methods.intro_zh: Bhattacharyya 距离先累加对应概率质量的几何平均重叠，再取负对数，使更大重叠对应更小距离。动画区分重叠系数和最终变换结果。本例各箱概率为正，无需数值下限即可保证对数有限。
steps_en: Declare one shared bin support and normalize nonnegative mass to sum to one.
Compute geometric-mean overlap in each bin.
Accumulate the displayed bin contributions, retaining any signed terms.
Apply negative log to the full overlap coefficient.
steps_zh: 声明共同箱支持集，将非负质量归一化为概率。
按该方法公式计算逐箱贡献。
累加所示贡献，保留可能出现的符号。
应用所示最后的根号、对数或直接求和。
caveats_en: Disjoint support gives zero overlap and infinite distance.
This log-overlap quantity generally lacks the triangle inequality.
caveats_zh: 支持集不相交时重叠为零、距离为无穷。
该负对数重叠量一般不满足三角不等式。
methods.input_label: Synthetic counts on eight shared bins; these bins are not timestamps.
animation_steps_en: Normalize counts on one shared bin support.
Compute geometric-mean overlap in each bin.
Accumulate the displayed bin contributions.
Apply negative log to the full overlap coefficient.

methods.title: Hellinger distance
methods.intro_en: Hellinger distance compares square-root probability vectors using a scaled Euclidean distance. The animation shows how transforming probabilities changes the coordinate gaps before squaring and accumulation. The factor one half inside the root fixes the common zero-to-one normalization. Shared bin definitions are essential because each square-root mass is compared with its corresponding bin.
methods.intro_zh: Hellinger 距离对概率开平方后，计算缩放的欧氏距离。动画展示变换如何改变坐标差，再平方累加。根号内的二分之一确定常见的 0 到 1 归一化。每个概率质量必须对应相同的箱定义。
steps_en: Declare one shared bin support and normalize nonnegative mass to sum to one.
Square the difference between square-root masses; divide by two.
Accumulate the displayed bin contributions, retaining any signed terms.
Take the square root of the accumulated contributions.
steps_zh: 声明共同箱支持集，将非负质量归一化为概率。
按该方法公式计算逐箱贡献。
累加所示贡献，保留可能出现的符号。
应用所示最后的根号、对数或直接求和。
caveats_en: This convention includes the factor 1/sqrt(2); some sources omit it.
A distance between histograms does not preserve the temporal order that generated them.
caveats_zh: 此约定包含 1/√2 因子，部分资料会省略。
直方图间距离不保留生成它们的原始时间顺序。
methods.input_label: Synthetic counts on eight shared bins; these bins are not timestamps.
animation_steps_en: Normalize counts on one shared bin support.
Square the difference between square-root masses; divide by two.
Accumulate the displayed bin contributions.
Take the square root of the accumulated contributions.

methods.title: Symmetric chi-square distance
methods.intro_en: This symmetric chi-square histogram distance divides squared probability differences by the combined mass of each bin, then sums half of those ratios. Small-mass bins can matter disproportionately relative to unweighted squared error. The animation follows the exact symmetric convention in the registry; it does not perform a statistical chi-square hypothesis test.
methods.intro_zh: 此对称卡方直方图距离用每箱概率和归一化平方概率差，再累加其一半。低概率箱相较无权平方误差可能获得更高影响。动画遵循登记表的对称定义，不进行卡方假设检验。
steps_en: Declare one shared bin support and normalize nonnegative mass to sum to one.
Divide squared bin differences by combined probability mass.
Accumulate the displayed bin contributions, retaining any signed terms.
Sum half of the mass-scaled squared differences.
steps_zh: 声明共同箱支持集，将非负质量归一化为概率。
按该方法公式计算逐箱贡献。
累加所示贡献，保留可能出现的符号。
应用所示最后的根号、对数或直接求和。
caveats_en: The name also denotes other asymmetric distances and test statistics; use the displayed formula.
A zero-over-zero bin needs an explicit zero contribution convention.
caveats_zh: 该名称还用于非对称距离和检验统计量，应以所示公式为准。
两侧均为零的箱需要显式约定贡献为零。
methods.input_label: Synthetic counts on eight shared bins; these bins are not timestamps.
animation_steps_en: Normalize counts on one shared bin support.
Divide squared bin differences by combined probability mass.
Accumulate the displayed bin contributions.
Sum half of the mass-scaled squared differences.

methods.title: Standardized Euclidean
methods.intro_en: Standardized Euclidean distance divides each squared coordinate residual by a supplied variance. Coordinates with greater reference variation receive less weight. This animation uses an explicit, fixed variance vector, so the comparison does not secretly estimate scale from the two sequences being scored. The final root gives a distance in variance-standardized coordinates.
methods.intro_zh: 标准化欧氏距离用给定方差缩放每个坐标的平方残差。参考变化更大的坐标权重较低。本动图使用显式固定的方差向量，不从待比较的两条序列暗中估计尺度，最后开平方得到标准化坐标空间中的距离。
steps_en: Align samples and provide a positive reference variance for every coordinate.
Square each residual and divide it by that coordinate's variance.
Sum the standardized squared contributions.
Take the square root; retain the same variance vector for future comparisons.
steps_zh: 对齐采样点，为每个坐标提供正的参考方差。
平方残差后除以对应坐标的方差。
累加标准化平方项。
开平方；后续比较保持同一参考方差。
caveats_en: Zero variances need an explicit exclusion or regularization policy.
Estimating variances using test data can leak information; use a declared reference fit.
caveats_zh: 零方差需要明确的剔除或正则化策略。
用测试数据估计方差可能泄漏信息；应声明参考拟合来源。
methods.input_label: Deterministic synthetic illustration; sample index is the time axis.
animation_steps_en: Fix a positive variance for each coordinate.
Divide squared gaps by reference variances.
Accumulate standardized squared errors.
Take the square root of the total.

methods.title: Z-normalized Euclidean
methods.intro_en: Z-normalized Euclidean first removes each sequence's own mean and divides by its standard deviation. The final Euclidean comparison therefore emphasizes the shape remaining on a common time grid. The input illustration deliberately includes an offset and gain difference so the normalized traces visibly differ from the raw signals.
methods.intro_zh: Z 标准化 Euclidean 比较先分别减去每条序列的均值，再除以各自标准差，随后在共同时间网格上比较标准化形状。本例刻意加入偏移和增益差，使原始信号与标准化后的曲线形成清晰对照。
steps_en: Estimate each series' own mean and population standard deviation.
Subtract that mean and divide by that standard deviation.
Accumulate squared normalized gaps.
Take the square root of the total.
steps_zh: 分别估计每条序列的均值和总体标准差。
分别去均值并除以标准差。
累加标准化后的平方差。
对总和开平方。
caveats_en: Positive gain and offset information is deliberately removed; distinct raw series can have zero distance.
Constant sequences need a separately declared convention; this illustration has positive variance.
caveats_zh: 正增益和偏移信息被主动去除；不同原序列可能距离为零。
常量序列必须另行规定处理方式；本例方差严格为正。
methods.input_label: Deterministic synthetic illustration; sample index is the time axis.
animation_steps_en: Estimate each series' mean and standard deviation.
Z-normalize each series independently.
Accumulate squared normalized gaps.
Take the square root.

methods.title: Z-normalized Manhattan
methods.intro_en: Z-normalized Manhattan first removes each sequence's own mean and divides by its standard deviation. The final Manhattan comparison therefore emphasizes the shape remaining on a common time grid. The input illustration deliberately includes an offset and gain difference so the normalized traces visibly differ from the raw signals.
methods.intro_zh: Z 标准化 Manhattan 比较先分别减去每条序列的均值，再除以各自标准差，随后在共同时间网格上比较标准化形状。本例刻意加入偏移和增益差，使原始信号与标准化后的曲线形成清晰对照。
steps_en: Estimate each series' own mean and population standard deviation.
Subtract that mean and divide by that standard deviation.

Trace the cheapest path that respects the band.
Take the square root of the constrained path cost.

methods.title: DTW with slope constraints
methods.intro_en: An Itakura-style parallelogram limits how strongly an alignment can stretch near either endpoint. This equal-length illustration uses slopes one half and two, anchored at the first and last samples. Dynamic programming then finds the least-cost path inside that explicitly shown region.
methods.intro_zh: Itakura 型平行四边形限制对齐路径在两端附近的伸缩程度。本例长度相等，允许斜率范围为二分之一至二，并同时锚定首尾观测。动态规划在图示允许区域内寻找最低代价路径。
steps_en: Choose raw observations and any neighborhood descriptor.
Compute local squared discrepancies; apply the indicated weights or admissibility mask.
At each admissible cell, add its local cost to the smallest predecessor cost.
Trace one minimizing path and take the square root of its accumulated objective.
steps_zh: 选择原始观测以及需要的邻域描述符。
计算局部平方误差，并施加指定权重或允许匹配的掩码。
在每个允许单元格，把局部代价加到三个前驱的最小累计代价上。
回溯一条最小化目标的路径，并对其累计目标值取平方根。
caveats_en: Mask discretization and unequal-length slope conventions differ across libraries; this card specifies an equal-length integer-grid example.
Signal scale, path constraints and final normalization must match before distances from different tools are compared.
caveats_zh: 不同库的离散掩码和异长斜率约定可能不同；本卡明确采用等长整数网格示例。
比较不同工具的数值之前，须统一信号尺度、路径约束和最终归一化。

methods.title: Weighted dynamic time warping
methods.intro_en: Weighted DTW changes the price of a match according to its displacement from the diagonal. The local squared discrepancy is multiplied by a logistic weight that increases with displacement. The animation then optimizes those weighted costs and displays the resulting path, without imposing a hard band.
methods.intro_zh: 加权 DTW 根据匹配位置偏离对角线的程度改变代价。局部平方误差乘以随位移增加的逻辑函数权重，再对这些加权代价求最优路径。本例不施加硬窗口。
steps_en: Choose raw observations and any neighborhood descriptor.
Compute local squared discrepancies; apply the indicated weights or admissibility mask.
At each admissible cell, add its local cost to the smallest predecessor cost.
Trace one minimizing path and take the square root of its accumulated objective.
steps_zh: 选择原始观测以及需要的邻域描述符。
计算局部平方误差，并施加指定权重或允许匹配的掩码。
在每个允许单元格，把局部代价加到三个前驱的最小累计代价上。
回溯一条最小化目标的路径，并对其累计目标值取平方根。
caveats_en: These weights are at most one: the penalty is relative across displacements, not an added nonnegative surcharge to ordinary DTW.
Signal scale, path constraints and final normalization must match before distances from different tools are compared.
caveats_zh: 这里的权重不超过一；所谓惩罚表示不同位移之间的相对权重，不是给普通 DTW 额外增加非负费用。

methods.title: DTW on first differences
methods.intro_en: This atlas entry applies DTW to first differences, so the alignment responds to changes rather than absolute levels. The first frames expose the transformed series before the local table is accumulated. It is an explicit first-difference variant; other DDTW implementations use a smoothed derivative estimator.
methods.intro_zh: 本条目对一阶差分使用 DTW，因此匹配依据是变化而非绝对水平。动图先展示变换后的序列，再构造累计表。本例明确使用一阶差分；其他 DDTW 实现可能采用平滑导数估计。
steps_en: Take first differences with the stated convention.
Compute local squared discrepancies; apply the indicated weights or admissibility mask.
At each admissible cell, add its local cost to the smallest predecessor cost.
Trace one minimizing path and take the square root of its accumulated objective.
steps_zh: 按明确约定计算一阶差分。
计算局部平方误差，并施加指定权重或允许匹配的掩码。
在每个允许单元格，把局部代价加到三个前驱的最小累计代价上。
回溯一条最小化目标的路径，并对其累计目标值取平方根。
methods.formula: Delta x_i=x_(i+1)-x_i; d=DTW(Delta x,Delta y), squared costs then square root
caveats_en: Differencing removes constant offsets and amplifies high-frequency noise. The result depends on the derivative estimator.
Signal scale, path constraints and final normalization must match before distances from different tools are compared.
caveats_zh: 差分消除常数偏移，也会放大高频噪声；结果取决于导数估计方法。

methods.title: Weighted DTW on differences
methods.intro_en: This variant first takes adjacent differences and then uses displacement-weighted DTW. It combines sensitivity to local changes with a preference for smaller index displacement. The displayed derivative table and weighted path belong to that stated composition, which need not equal every library's WDDTW convention.
methods.intro_zh: 该变体先计算相邻差分，再进行位移加权 DTW，结合局部变化比较与较小索引位移偏好。图中导数表和加权路径对应这里明确给出的组合，不保证与所有库的 WDDTW 约定相同。
steps_en: Take first differences with the stated convention.
Compute local squared discrepancies; apply the indicated weights or admissibility mask.
At each admissible cell, add its local cost to the smallest predecessor cost.
Trace one minimizing path and take the square root of its accumulated objective.
steps_zh: 按明确约定计算一阶差分。
计算局部平方误差，并施加指定权重或允许匹配的掩码。
在每个允许单元格，把局部代价加到三个前驱的最小累计代价上。
回溯一条最小化目标的路径，并对其累计目标值取平方根。
methods.formula: d=sqrt(min_path sum w(|i-j|)*(Delta x_i-Delta y_j)^2), g=0.6
caveats_en: Both derivative estimation and the logistic slope change the answer; offset tolerance does not imply robustness to arbitrary noise.
Signal scale, path constraints and final normalization must match before distances from different tools are compared.
caveats_zh: 导数估计和逻辑权重斜率都会改变结果；容忍水平偏移并不意味着对任意噪声稳健。

methods.title: Soft dynamic time warping
methods.intro_en: Soft-DTW replaces the hard minimum over alignment alternatives with a log-sum-exp soft minimum. Many paths contribute to the result, and the gradient with respect to local costs gives expected cell occupancy. The score is a smooth objective and may be negative or favor a point different from the input itself.
methods.intro_zh: Soft-DTW 用 log-sum-exp 软最小值替代路径选择中的硬最小值。多个路径共同贡献目标值，对局部代价求导得到每个单元格的期望占据权重。它是平滑目标，可以为负，也可能不在输入自身处取得最小值。
steps_en: Form the squared local discrepancy table and choose gamma=0.7.
Use -gamma*log(sum(exp(-previous/gamma))) in each DP update.
Propagate derivatives backward to display expected alignment occupancy across multiple paths.
Read the signed soft objective without choosing a unique path.
steps_zh: 构造平方局部误差表，设平滑参数 gamma=0.7。
每步动态规划使用 -gamma*log(sum(exp(-previous/gamma)))。
反向传播导数，显示多个路径共同形成的期望对齐占据权重。
读取有符号的软目标值，不选择唯一对齐路径。
caveats_en: Gamma controls the spread over alignments; this example uses squared local costs and no path band.
Raw soft-DTW can be negative and has an entropic self-bias; do not treat it as a conventional nonnegative distance.
caveats_zh: Gamma 控制路径权重的分散程度；本例使用平方局部代价，不加路径窗口。
原始 soft-DTW 可以为负并具有熵正则化自偏差，不能直接作为普通非负距离理解。

animation_steps_en: Compute squared local costs and set gamma to 0.7.
Replace hard predecessor minima by a soft minimum.
Propagate derivatives to obtain expected cell occupancy.
Read the signed soft objective; no unique path is selected.

methods.title: Soft-DTW divergence
methods.intro_en: The corrected soft-DTW divergence subtracts self-alignment terms from the cross-series soft score. This removes its nonzero self-cost by construction. The animation shows both the diffuse alignment occupancy and the three-term correction; theoretical nonnegativity and identification results depend on the ground-cost assumptions.
methods.intro_zh: 修正 soft-DTW 散度从交叉序列分数中扣除两个自对齐项，因此相同输入的自代价按构造归零。动图展示分散的对齐占据权重和三项修正；非负性与可识别性的理论结论依赖局部代价条件。
steps_en: Form the squared local discrepancy table and choose gamma=0.7.
Use -gamma*log(sum(exp(-previous/gamma))) in each DP update.
Propagate derivatives backward to display expected alignment occupancy across multiple paths.
Subtract half of softDTW(x,x) and half of softDTW(y,y).
steps_zh: 构造平方局部误差表，设平滑参数 gamma=0.7。
每步动态规划使用 -gamma*log(sum(exp(-previous/gamma)))。
反向传播导数，显示多个路径共同形成的期望对齐占据权重。
分别扣除 softDTW(x,x) 和 softDTW(y,y) 的一半。
caveats_en: Gamma controls the spread over alignments; this example uses squared local costs and no path band.
A divergence is not automatically a metric; its properties depend on the ground cost and it need not satisfy the triangle inequality.
caveats_zh: Gamma 控制路径权重的分散程度；本例使用平方局部代价，不加路径窗口。
散度并不自动成为度量；其性质依赖局部代价，也不必满足三角不等式。

methods.title: LCSS matched fraction
methods.intro_en: LCSS counts an order-preserving set of sufficiently close sample pairs. Unmatched samples may be skipped, so the result describes matched coverage rather than the magnitude of every residual. The animation uses a tolerance of 0.35 and divides the match count by the shorter sequence length.
methods.intro_zh: LCSS 寻找保持先后顺序且足够接近的观测配对。未匹配点可以跳过，因此结果反映匹配覆盖率，不累加全部数值误差。本例容差为 0.35，并以较短序列长度归一化匹配数量。
steps_en: Set the stated local scoring rule, tolerance and boundary conditions.
Count tolerance matches and carry forward the larger match count when skipping.
Trace the selected predecessor operations from the complete-prefix state.
Read the final score with the normalization explicitly stated below.
steps_zh: 设置明确的局部计分规则、容差与边界条件。
累计容差内匹配，跳过观测时保留较大的匹配计数。
从完整前缀状态沿选定的前驱操作回溯。
按下方明确的归一化约定读取最终分数。
caveats_en: Tolerance changes which pairs count as matches. Missing subsequences may be ignored by the shorter-length normalization.
The small arrays are an algorithm illustration, not evidence of retrieval or classification quality.
caveats_zh: 容差改变哪些配对算匹配；以较短长度归一化可能忽略较长序列中未匹配的部分。
这些小数组用于解释计算过程，不构成检索或分类性能证据。

Count ordered matches while allowing unmatched samples to be skipped.
Trace the chosen matched pairs in their original order.
Divide the match count by the shorter sequence length.

methods.title: One minus LCSS similarity
methods.intro_en: This distance-like transform is one minus the normalized LCSS match count. It retains the order-preserving, tolerance-based matching rule. The final conversion reverses the direction of the score without restoring information discarded by skipped points or thresholding; different sequences can therefore receive zero distance.
methods.intro_zh: 该距离形式等于一减归一化 LCSS 匹配数量，仍采用保持顺序的容差匹配。最后的变换只反转分数方向，无法恢复跳过观测或阈值判断丢失的信息，因此不同序列也可能得到零距离。
steps_en: Set the stated local scoring rule, tolerance and boundary conditions.
Count tolerance matches and carry forward the larger match count when skipping.
Trace the selected predecessor operations from the complete-prefix state.
Convert the count to one minus its shorter-length-normalized value.
steps_zh: 设置明确的局部计分规则、容差与边界条件。
累计容差内匹配，跳过观测时保留较大的匹配计数。
从完整前缀状态沿选定的前驱操作回溯。
将匹配数量除以较短长度，再用一减去该比例。
caveats_en: One minus a similarity need not satisfy metric axioms. Zero here means full tolerance-based coverage of the shorter sequence.
The small arrays are an algorithm illustration, not evidence of retrieval or classification quality.
caveats_zh: 一减相似度不保证满足度量公理；这里的零值表示较短序列在容差内被完全覆盖。
这些小数组用于解释计算过程，不构成检索或分类性能证据。

methods.title: Edit distance on real sequences
methods.intro_en: EDR replaces the size of a sample discrepancy with a thresholded substitution cost. A nearby pair costs zero, a mismatching substitution costs one, and insertions or deletions cost one. Dynamic programming finds the least expensive edit sequence; this example reports EchoTime's length-normalized default.
methods.intro_zh: EDR 把观测差异转成阈值替换代价：相近配对为零，不匹配替换为一，插入和删除也为一。动态规划寻找费用最低的编辑序列；本例采用 EchoTime 默认的长度归一化输出。
steps_en: Set the stated local scoring rule, tolerance and boundary conditions.
Choose the cheapest substitution, insertion or deletion for each prefix.
Trace the selected predecessor operations from the complete-prefix state.
Read the final score with the normalization explicitly stated below.
steps_zh: 设置明确的局部计分规则、容差与边界条件。
逐个前缀选择费用最低的替换、插入或删除。
从完整前缀状态沿选定的前驱操作回溯。
按下方明确的归一化约定读取最终分数。
caveats_en: The amplitude of a mismatch beyond epsilon is discarded. Normalization and epsilon must be specified when comparing implementations.
The small arrays are an algorithm illustration, not evidence of retrieval or classification quality.
caveats_zh: 超过 epsilon 后的误差幅度被丢弃；比较不同实现时须明确容差与归一化。
这些小数组用于解释计算过程，不构成检索或分类性能证据。

methods.title: SWALE rewards and gap costs
methods.intro_en: SWALE scores tolerance-based matches with a reward and unmatched observations with a gap penalty. Its recurrence combines the number of accepted matches with the price of omitted observations. This example uses reward 2, gap score -0.5 and epsilon 0.35; the raw score is not normalized to a probability.
methods.intro_zh: SWALE 对容差内的匹配给奖励，对未匹配的观测施加间隙惩罚。递推同时考虑接受的匹配数量与省略观测的费用。本例奖励为 2、间隙分数为 -0.5、容差为 0.35；原始分数没有归一化为概率。
steps_en: Set the stated local scoring rule, tolerance and boundary conditions.
Reward a tolerance match; otherwise choose the less costly gap transition.
Trace the selected predecessor operations from the complete-prefix state.
Read the final score with the normalization explicitly stated below.
steps_zh: 设置明确的局部计分规则、容差与边界条件。
对容差匹配给予奖励，否则选择费用较低的间隙转移。

caveats_en: Rewards, gap penalties and sequence length influence the score scale. This implements the paper's scoring recurrence, not its FTSE acceleration.
The small arrays are an algorithm illustration, not evidence of retrieval or classification quality.
caveats_zh: 奖励、间隙惩罚和序列长度都会影响分数量级；本例演示论文的计分递推，没有实现 FTSE 加速。

caveats_zh: 间隙值选择会改变代价；若间隙值也属于合法观测，不同原始列表可以得到零 ERP 距离。

methods.title: Move, split and merge
methods.intro_en: MSM transforms one ordered sequence through move, split and merge operations. Moving costs the absolute change in value. Split/merge costs depend on a base cost and neighboring values, so the recurrence uses local context instead of a fixed gap symbol. The animation displays its cumulative operation costs.
methods.intro_zh: MSM 通过移动、分裂和合并操作变换有序序列。移动费用是数值的绝对变化；分裂与合并费用取决于基础费用和邻近数值，因此递推使用局部上下文而非固定间隙符号。动图展示这些操作的累计费用。

Compare a move with context-dependent split and merge costs.
Trace the selected predecessor operations from the complete-prefix state.
Read the final score with the normalization explicitly stated below.
steps_zh: 设置明确的局部计分规则、容差与边界条件。
比较移动费用与依赖上下文的分裂、合并费用。

The small arrays are an algorithm illustration, not evidence of retrieval or classification quality.
caveats_zh: 本例是 c=0.6 的单变量定义；多变量的联合式与独立式推广须另行指定。
这些小数组用于解释计算过程，不构成检索或分类性能证据。

Accumulate the cheapest operation for each prefix pair.
Trace the selected move, split and merge decisions.

methods.title: Time warp edit distance
methods.intro_en: TWED combines edit penalties, consecutive-value changes and timestamp discrepancies. A match compares both the current pair and the preceding pair; deletions also include elapsed-time stiffness. The animation uses the zero-value, zero-time sentinel and infinite leading boundaries from EchoTime's corrected recurrence.
methods.intro_zh: TWED 联合考虑编辑惩罚、相邻数值变化和时间戳差异。匹配同时比较当前配对与前一个配对；删除还包括经过时间的刚度代价。动图使用 EchoTime 修正递推中的零值零时刻哨兵及无穷边界。
steps_en: Set the stated local scoring rule, tolerance and boundary conditions.
Combine value changes, time stiffness and deletion penalties in the minimum-cost recurrence.
Trace the selected predecessor operations from the complete-prefix state.
Read the final score with the normalization explicitly stated below.
steps_zh: 设置明确的局部计分规则、容差与边界条件。
在最小代价递推中结合数值变化、时间刚度和删除惩罚。
从完整前缀状态沿选定的前驱操作回溯。
按下方明确的归一化约定读取最终分数。
caveats_en: Positive stiffness, timestamps, the sentinel and boundary conventions matter to metric claims. A constrained or resampled approximation does not automatically inherit them.
The small arrays are an algorithm illustration, not evidence of retrieval or classification quality.
caveats_zh: 正刚度、时间戳、哨兵和边界约定都是度量结论的条件；加约束或重采样近似不自动继承这些性质。

methods.title: Discrete Frechet bottleneck
methods.intro_en: Discrete Frechet comparison minimizes the largest local separation along a monotone traversal. This differs from objectives that add every local mismatch: one difficult pair can determine the bottleneck. Here observations are points on the value axis, with order preserved and no extra time coordinate in the local norm.
methods.intro_zh: 离散 Fréchet 比较最小化单调遍历过程中最大的局部距离。单个困难配对可能决定最终瓶颈。本例将观测视为数值轴上的点，保留其顺序，但局部范数不额外包含时间坐标。
steps_en: Set the stated local scoring rule, tolerance and boundary conditions.
Keep the larger of the present separation and the smallest predecessor bottleneck.
Trace the selected predecessor operations from the complete-prefix state.
Read the final score with the normalization explicitly stated below.
steps_zh: 设置明确的局部计分规则、容差与边界条件。
在当前距离和最小前驱瓶颈之间取较大者。
从完整前缀状态沿选定的前驱操作回溯。
按下方明确的归一化约定读取最终分数。

The small arrays are an algorithm illustration, not evidence of retrieval or classification quality.

The entire prefix table contributes to a global solution ending at its bottom-right cell. The time-series scoring rule is specified here, rather than implied by the algorithm name.

The small arrays are an algorithm illustration, not evidence of retrieval or classification quality.

methods.title: Local sequence alignment
methods.intro_en: Smith-Waterman allows an alignment to restart at zero, so it can select matching internal subsequences while leaving unrelated ends unused. This explicit numerical example uses the same threshold substitution scores as the global card. The best cell may occur anywhere, and traceback stops when the score returns to zero.

Start at the maximum score and stop traceback at zero.
Read the final score with the normalization explicitly stated below.

在每个单元格增加从零开始选项，并最大化分数。

methods.title: DTW on local shape descriptors
methods.intro_en: shapeDTW compares short neighborhoods around samples so that a match reflects local context. Here each descriptor contains three raw values with edge repetition, and DTW minimizes squared descriptor differences. The animation reports the descriptor-space objective, an explicit variant rather than a raw-signal score recomputed along its path.
methods.intro_zh: shapeDTW 用观测周围的短邻域描述局部形状。本例将三个原始数值组成描述符，边界使用重复填充，然后最小化描述符之间的平方差。动图报告描述符空间的目标值，不是沿该路径重新计算的原始信号距离。
steps_en: Construct a three-sample raw neighborhood descriptor at each index, repeating edge values.
Compute local squared discrepancies; apply the indicated weights or admissibility mask.
At each admissible cell, add its local cost to the smallest predecessor cost.
Trace one minimizing path and take the square root of its accumulated objective.
steps_zh: 逐点构造三个采样值的原始邻域描述符，在边界重复端点数值。
计算局部平方误差，并施加指定权重或允许匹配的掩码。
在每个允许单元格，把局部代价加到三个前驱的最小累计代价上。
回溯一条最小化目标的路径，并对其累计目标值取平方根。
caveats_en: Descriptor radius, scaling and the choice to rescore the final path in raw space all change the method. No trained descriptor is used here.
Signal scale, path constraints and final normalization must match before distances from different tools are compared.
caveats_zh: 邻域半径、缩放以及是否在原空间重新计分都会改变结果；本例没有训练描述符。
比较不同工具的数值之前，须统一信号尺度、路径约束和最终归一化。

methods.title: Linear inner-product kernel
methods.intro_en: The linear kernel adds products of corresponding coordinates. Its animation shows which indices contribute positively or negatively before adding them into the inner product. It preserves amplitude and offset effects unless preprocessing removes them, and its scale grows with vector energy.
methods.intro_zh: 线性核将对应坐标的乘积相加。动图先展示各位置的正负贡献，再累加成内积。若预处理没有消除幅度与偏移，它们会保留在结果中；分数量级随向量能量变化。
steps_en: Use the same aligned coordinate system for both vectors.
Compute and sum the coordinatewise contributions shown in the plot.
Apply the specified scalar kernel transformation to that complete sum.
Read the pair score; kernel magnitude is not a calibrated similarity probability.
steps_zh: 对两个向量使用同一个已对齐坐标系。
计算图示逐坐标贡献并求和。
对完整求和结果施加指定的标量核变换。
读取成对分数；核函数量级不是校准后的相似概率。
caveats_en: An inner product is not bounded by one and can be negative; normalization would produce a different kernel or cosine score.
No local time warping is performed by this aligned-vector construction.
caveats_zh: 内积没有一的上界，也可以为负；归一化会产生不同的核或余弦分数。
此已对齐向量构造不执行局部时间扭曲。

methods.title: Polynomial kernel
methods.intro_en: The polynomial kernel first computes an inner product, then applies a shifted integer power. Here degree three creates nonlinear interactions implicitly without constructing every product feature. The animation separates the coordinate sum from its nonlinear expansion, so the large final magnitude is not mistaken for a probability.
methods.intro_zh: 多项式核先计算内积，再对平移后的结果取整数次幂。本例次数为三，隐式表示非线性交互而不逐一构造乘积特征。动图分开显示坐标求和与非线性展开，最终大数值不能解释为概率。

Compute and sum the coordinatewise contributions shown in the plot.
Apply the specified scalar kernel transformation to that complete sum.
Read the pair score; kernel magnitude is not a calibrated similarity probability.
steps_zh: 对两个向量使用同一个已对齐坐标系。
计算图示逐坐标贡献并求和。
对完整求和结果施加指定的标量核变换。
读取成对分数；核函数量级不是校准后的相似概率。
caveats_en: The usual positive-semidefinite guarantee uses a nonnegative scale/offset and integer degree. Large norms or degrees can dominate numerically.
No local time warping is performed by this aligned-vector construction.
caveats_zh: 通常的半正定保证使用非负尺度、非负偏置和整数次数；较大范数或次数可能在数值上主导结果。

methods.intro_en: This sigmoid score maps an affine inner product through tanh. The animation shows saturation: sufficiently large input scores compress into a narrow output range. The formula is commonly called a sigmoid kernel, but arbitrary scale and offset choices do not guarantee a positive-semidefinite Gram matrix.
methods.intro_zh: 该 sigmoid 分数将内积的仿射变换送入 tanh。动图展示饱和现象：较大输入分数被压缩到很窄的输出范围。该公式常称为 sigmoid 核，但任意尺度与偏置选择不保证 Gram 矩阵半正定。
steps_en: Use the same aligned coordinate system for both vectors.
Compute and sum the coordinatewise contributions shown in the plot.
Apply the specified scalar kernel transformation to that complete sum.

计算图示逐坐标贡献并求和。

读取成对分数；核函数量级不是校准后的相似概率。
caveats_en: A bounded output does not establish positive semidefiniteness or a probabilistic interpretation; saturation can hide changes in the input dot product.
No local time warping is performed by this aligned-vector construction.
caveats_zh: 输出有界不能证明半正定性或概率解释；饱和可能掩盖输入内积变化。

methods.title: Gaussian kernel on aligned values
methods.intro_en: The Gaussian RBF kernel converts squared Euclidean discrepancy between aligned vectors into an exponentially decreasing score. The animation first accumulates squared residuals, then locates that total on the exponential curve. Its bandwidth controls how quickly disagreement reduces the score, while time alignment remains fixed.
methods.intro_zh: 高斯 RBF 核将已对齐向量的平方欧氏差异转成指数递减分数。动图先累加平方残差，再把总量定位到指数曲线上。带宽控制分数随差异下降的速度，时间对齐保持固定。
steps_en: Use the same aligned coordinate system for both vectors.
Compute and sum the coordinatewise contributions shown in the plot.
Apply the specified scalar kernel transformation to that complete sum.
Read the pair score; kernel magnitude is not a calibrated similarity probability.
steps_zh: 对两个向量使用同一个已对齐坐标系。
计算图示逐坐标贡献并求和。
对完整求和结果施加指定的标量核变换。
读取成对分数；核函数量级不是校准后的相似概率。

No local time warping is performed by this aligned-vector construction.

methods.title: Exponential transform of DTW
methods.intro_en: This construction first selects the minimum-cost DTW path and then exponentially transforms its squared distance. The animation shows the path calculation before the score conversion. Although the formula resembles a Gaussian kernel, replacing Euclidean distance by DTW does not automatically preserve positive semidefiniteness.
methods.intro_zh: 该构造先选择最低代价 DTW 路径，再对距离平方做指数变换。动图先展示路径计算，再展示分数转换。将欧氏距离替换成 DTW 不自动保留高斯核的半正定性。
steps_en: Build squared local costs and a monotone DTW recurrence.
Select the path with the least accumulated discrepancy.
Use that accumulated cost as DTW squared in exp(-gamma*cost).
Interpret the decreasing score with gamma=0.7 and the stated local norm.
steps_zh: 构造平方局部代价与单调 DTW 递推。
选择累计差异最小的路径。
把该累计代价作为 DTW 平方代入 exp(-gamma*cost)。
结合 gamma=0.7 和明确的局部范数理解该递减分数。
methods.formula: K=exp(-0.7*DTW(x,y)^2), DTW uses squared costs then square root
caveats_en: A DTW-based exponential may produce an indefinite Gram matrix. Do not infer kernel-method guarantees from its name.
The value changes with the path band, local cost and distance normalization.
caveats_zh: DTW 指数形式可能得到不定 Gram 矩阵；不能从名称推断核方法保证。
路径窗口、局部代价和距离归一化都会改变结果。

animation_steps_en: Build a squared-cost DTW table.
Find the minimum-cost monotone alignment path.
Use the accumulated cost as the squared DTW distance.
Map that cost through exp(-0.7 times cost).

methods.title: Exponential transform of SBD
methods.intro_en: SBD selects the largest normalized cross-correlation over global shifts, then subtracts it from one. This atlas construction maps that SBD value through exp(-2*SBD). The lag sweep makes its shift tolerance visible, while its full-series normalization distinguishes it from overlap-normalized Pearson correlation.
methods.intro_zh: SBD 在全局平移中选择最大的归一化互相关，再用一减去该值。本图谱构造进一步计算 exp(-2*SBD)。动图逐个扫描滞后，展示平移容忍性；采用完整序列能量归一化，与重叠区域 Pearson 相关不同。
steps_en: Z-normalize both series using their own full-series mean and standard deviation.
Evaluate zero-padded cross-correlation at every global lag.
Set SBD to one minus the largest full-energy-normalized correlation.
Apply exp(-2*SBD) to obtain the stated kernel-like score.
steps_zh: 用各自完整序列的均值和标准差进行 z 标准化。
在每个全局滞后处计算零填充互相关。
令 SBD 等于一减完整能量归一化相关的最大值。
应用 exp(-2*SBD)，得到明确约定的核形式分数。
caveats_en: Maximizing over shifts and exponentiating a distance-like score do not establish positive semidefiniteness.
Only one global lag is chosen. Constant inputs have undefined statistical normalization and need an explicit software convention.
caveats_zh: 对平移取最大值再指数化距离形式分数，不能证明半正定性。
只选择一个全局滞后；常数输入的统计归一化未定义，需要明确的软件约定。

Set SBD to one minus the largest lag correlation.
Compute exp(-2 times SBD).

methods.title: Exponential soft-DTW divergence
methods.intro_en: This imported atlas name denotes an exponential of the self-corrected soft-DTW divergence. It first includes contributions from multiple alignments, subtracts both self terms, then applies exp(-D/gamma). This explicit construction is separate from directly exponentiating raw soft-DTW or choosing a modified local kernel for GAK.
methods.intro_zh: 本图谱名称对应自修正 soft-DTW 散度的指数形式。先综合多个对齐路径，减去两个自对齐项，再计算 exp(-D/gamma)。该明确构造区别于直接指数化原始 soft-DTW，也区别于为 GAK 选择修正局部核。
steps_en: Compute cross and self soft-DTW objectives with the same gamma and local cost.
Inspect the diffuse occupancy of alternative alignments.
Subtract the self terms to obtain the corrected divergence D.
Evaluate exp(-D/gamma) using gamma=0.7.
steps_zh: 使用相同 gamma 和局部代价计算交叉及自对齐 soft-DTW。
检查备选对齐的分散占据权重。
扣除自对齐项得到修正散度 D。
使用 gamma=0.7 计算 exp(-D/gamma)。
caveats_en: A corrected divergence does not by itself prove that its exponential is a positive-semidefinite kernel for an arbitrary ground cost.
This gamma is used for both soft alignment and the final exponential; a separate outer bandwidth would define another variant.
caveats_zh: 修正散度本身不能证明对任意局部代价，其指数形式都是半正定核。
这里同一个 gamma 同时控制软对齐与最终指数变换；若另设外层带宽，则得到另一变体。

methods.input_label: Deterministic illustrative arrays; no benchmark data

result.label: kernel score
result.detail: The explicit definition and parameters shown on this card.

animation_steps_en: Compute cross and self soft-DTW with gamma 0.7.
Inspect the diffuse occupancy of alternative alignments.
Subtract the self terms to obtain the corrected divergence.
Compute exp(-divergence / 0.7).

methods.title: Global alignment kernel
methods.intro_en: The Global Alignment Kernel adds products of local similarities over all monotone alignment paths. The dynamic program uses a sum rather than choosing a minimum-cost predecessor. Here the local kernel is phi/(2-phi), with phi a Gaussian, following a sufficient positive-definiteness construction; the displayed result is unnormalized.
methods.intro_zh: 全局对齐核将所有单调对齐路径上的局部相似度乘积相加。动态规划对前驱求和，不选择最低代价前驱。本例局部核为 phi/(2-phi)，其中 phi 是高斯核，对应一个充分的正定性构造；输出未做自相似归一化。
steps_en: Build phi=exp(-squared_cost/(2*sigma^2)) with sigma=1, then kappa=phi/(2-phi).
Multiply each local kappa by the sum of its three predecessor path weights.
Accumulate every monotone alignment; do not replace the sum with a maximum or minimum.
Read the unnormalized path sum; optional self-normalization is a separate step.
steps_zh: 用 sigma=1 构造 phi=exp(-平方代价/(2*sigma^2))，再令 kappa=phi/(2-phi)。
每个局部 kappa 乘以三个前驱路径权重之和。
累加全部单调对齐，不能将求和换成最大或最小值。
读取未归一化路径和；可选的自相似归一化是另一个步骤。
caveats_en: An arbitrary local similarity or hard path restriction does not inherit the stated positive-definiteness construction.

methods.title: Permutation-entropy distance
methods.intro_en: Turn length-three windows into ordering patterns and compute each distribution's normalized Shannon entropy. Compare the two scalar entropies with an absolute difference. The score measures equality of this particular summary, so distinct pattern distributions can still have zero distance.

Stably rank each window and count all six possible permutations.
Compute H=-sum(p log p)/log(6) for each distribution.
Take |H(x)-H(y)| and remember that entropy discards pattern identities.

稳定排序各窗口，并统计全部六种排列。

计算 |H(x)-H(y)|，同时注意熵舍弃具体模式身份。
caveats_en: Order 3, delay 1 and stable tie-breaking by earlier position are explicit choices; frequent ties can change the interpretation.
Short sequences provide sparse pattern counts; overlapping windows are not independent samples.
Equal entropy does not imply equal ordinal distributions or similar dynamics.

短序列的模式统计稀疏，重叠窗口也不是独立样本。

methods.title: Linear trend features distance
methods.intro_en: Fit an ordinary least-squares line to each series on the sample-index axis. Compare the intercept, slope and population standard deviation of residuals. This is EchoTime's three-coordinate trend description; it retains overall direction and unexplained variation while compressing local structure. Euclidean distance retains differences in both vector scale and coordinates.
methods.intro_zh: 以样本索引为时间轴，对每条序列拟合普通最小二乘直线，再比较截距、斜率和残差的总体标准差。这是 EchoTime 的三坐标趋势描述，保留总体方向与未解释波动，同时压缩局部结构。 欧氏距离同时保留向量尺度与坐标差异。

Collect the computed coordinates in the same fixed order for both inputs.
Take the Euclidean norm of the coordinate differences.
Interpret the score in this representation, accounting for the information it discards.

把计算得到的坐标按同一个固定顺序组成两个向量。
对坐标差计算欧氏范数。

caveats_en: The slope uses sample index, so changing the sampling interval changes its interpretation; physical-time comparisons require consistent units.
Intercept, slope and residual SD have different scales. Curved trends and different residual patterns can share the same vector.
A metric on these feature vectors can be only a pseudometric on the original series when the representation loses information.

methods.title: SAX Hamming distance
methods.intro_en: Convert each standardized series to a four-symbol SAX word, then count the fraction of positions with different symbols. This treats every mismatch equally, including adjacent bins; it is a distance between words, with information lost during aggregation and quantization.
methods.intro_zh: 把每条标准化序列转换为四符号 SAX 单词，再统计对应位置符号不同的比例。所有不匹配均等计数，包括相邻区间；它比较符号单词，聚合和量化已经损失信息。
steps_en: Z-normalize each complete series and use four equal PAA blocks.
Quantize each mean with shared standard-normal quartile breakpoints.
Count mismatching symbols.
Divide the mismatch count by four.
steps_zh: 对各完整序列做 z 标准化，并计算四个等长 PAA 区间。
使用共享标准正态四分位断点量化各区间均值。
统计符号不匹配数。
将不匹配数除以四。
caveats_en: Gaussian breakpoints are a coding convention; they do not make arbitrary observed signals normally distributed.
Hamming on words does not have the SAX Euclidean lower-bound interpretation.
Both PAA aggregation and quantization can map distinct signals to the same code.
caveats_zh: 高斯断点是一种编码约定，不会使任意观测信号变成正态分布。
单词上的 Hamming 距离不具有 SAX 欧氏下界的含义。
PAA 聚合和量化都可能把不同信号映射为相同代码。

methods.title: SAX MINDIST lower bound
methods.intro_en: Compare SAX words using the minimum gap between their symbol intervals, sum squared gaps and multiply by the PAA length factor. Equal or adjacent symbols contribute zero. In this example all paired symbols are adjacent, demonstrating why a valid lower bound can be zero for distinct series.
methods.intro_zh: 以 SAX 符号区间之间的最小间隔比较两个单词，累加间隔平方后加入 PAA 长度系数。相同或相邻符号贡献为零。本例各对应符号都相邻，展示了有效下界为何可对不同序列返回零。
steps_en: Z-normalize each complete series and use four equal PAA blocks.
Quantize each mean with shared standard-normal quartile breakpoints.
Look up the minimum gap between the two symbol intervals.
Take sqrt(n/w)*sqrt(sum(gap^2)); this is a lower-bound calculation.
steps_zh: 对各完整序列做 z 标准化，并计算四个等长 PAA 区间。
使用共享标准正态四分位断点量化各区间均值。
查找两个符号区间之间的最小间隔。
计算 sqrt(n/w)*sqrt(sum(gap^2))，得到下界。
caveats_en: Gaussian breakpoints are a coding convention; they do not make arbitrary observed signals normally distributed.
The Euclidean lower-bound interpretation requires the same normalized length, partitions and ordered breakpoints; lower-bounding does not imply metric axioms.
Both PAA aggregation and quantization can map distinct signals to the same code.
caveats_zh: 高斯断点是一种编码约定，不会使任意观测信号变成正态分布。
欧氏下界解释要求相同的标准化长度、分段和有序断点；具有下界性质不等于满足度量公理。
PAA 聚合和量化都可能把不同信号映射为相同代码。

Suppress consecutive duplicate words and count both series in one shared vocabulary.
Accumulate matching word-count products divided by both vector norms.
Read cosine similarity between count vectors.
steps_zh: 滑动八点窗口并标准化，再用共享 SAX 字母表编码四个 PAA 均值。
抑制连续重复词，在一个共享词表中对两条序列计数。

Global motif order and absolute window level/scale are discarded; a similar bag need not imply aligned events.

methods.title: Autoregressive-coefficient distance
methods.intro_en: Fit a separately centered AR(2) model by conditional least squares to each short input, then compare the two lag coefficients. Fit the same AR(2) equation by ordinary least squares for each input.
Compare the corresponding lag-one and lag-two coefficients.
Take the Euclidean norm of the coefficient difference.

分别用普通最小二乘拟合相同形式的 AR(2) 方程。
比较对应的一阶和二阶滞后系数。
计算系数差的欧氏范数。

methods.title: AR log-spectrum distance
methods.intro_en: Fit the same centered AR(2) model to each input and evaluate its implied spectrum on 17 shared frequencies. The animation compares natural-log spectra with Euclidean distance. The two final fits are stable; their fitted residual variances are included, so both spectral shape and power level affect the score.
methods.intro_zh: 对两条输入拟合相同的中心化 AR(2) 模型，并在 17 个共享频点上计算模型隐含谱。动图以欧氏距离比较自然对数谱。两个最终拟合均稳定，且纳入拟合残差方差，因此谱形状和功率水平都会影响分数。

Check stability and evaluate sigma^2 / |1-phi_1 exp(-iw)-phi_2 exp(-2iw)|^2.
Take natural logs on the same 17-point frequency grid.
Take the Euclidean norm of the log-spectrum difference.

检查稳定性，计算 sigma^2 / |1-phi_1 exp(-iw)-phi_2 exp(-2iw)|^2。
在相同的 17 点频率网格上取自然对数。
计算对数谱差的欧氏范数。

methods.title: Symmetric AR cross-prediction error
methods.intro_en: Fit centered AR(2) models, apply the x model to y and the y model to x, then average their one-step mean-squared errors. This measures compatibility under a specified predictive model and centering convention. Even a self-comparison can remain positive because fitted innovations are not zero.
methods.intro_zh: 拟合中心化 AR(2) 模型，用 x 的模型预测 y，再用 y 的模型预测 x，最后平均两个一步预测均方误差。它度量指定预测模型和中心化约定下的兼容性；即使自比较，也可能因拟合创新不为零而得到正值。
steps_en: Fit one centered conditional-OLS AR(2) model to each full input.
Transfer the x coefficients to centered y, and transfer the y coefficients to centered x.
Compute each direction's one-step squared residuals on the available 14 lagged targets.
Average the two directional MSEs; interpret this as error rather than a mathematical metric.
steps_zh: 分别对完整输入拟合中心化条件最小二乘 AR(2)。
将 x 的系数用于中心化 y，再将 y 的系数用于中心化 x。
对各方向的 14 个可用滞后目标计算一步预测残差平方。
平均两个方向的 MSE，把结果解释为误差分数。
animation_steps_en: Fit one centered conditional least-squares AR(2) model to each input.
Use the x model to predict y, then use the y model to predict x.
Compute each direction's one-step mean-squared prediction error.
Average the two errors; even self-error can be positive.

methods.title: Discretized Markov-transition distance
methods.intro_en: Map observations to three shared value states and count consecutive state transitions. Row-normalized count matrices describe the next-state distribution conditional on the current state. Compare these matrices by Frobenius distance. This illustrates a specified first-order discretization, without establishing that either signal is generated by a Markov chain.
methods.intro_zh: 把观测映射到三个共享数值状态，统计连续状态转移。按行归一化的计数矩阵描述给定当前状态时的下一状态分布，再以 Frobenius 距离比较两个矩阵。这只是指定的一阶离散化示例，并未证明信号由 Markov 链生成。
steps_en: Use shared thresholds 0 and 0.7, then count consecutive transitions between the three states.
Divide each row by its outgoing-transition count; every row is observed in this example.
Square differences between corresponding conditional transition probabilities.
Sum these squared differences and take their square root, giving the Frobenius norm.
steps_zh: 用共享阈值 0 和 0.7 定义三个状态，再统计连续转移。
用各行转出总数进行归一化；本例每行均有观测。
对相对应的条件转移概率计算差的平方。
累加这些平方差并开平方，得到 Frobenius 范数。
caveats_en: State boundaries and sampling interval define the estimated transitions; independently chosen bins would not have matching meanings.
Unobserved rows need a documented smoothing or missing-row policy. No smoothing is used here because every row has observations.

steps_en: Keep matching channel identities and define channelwise preprocessing.

methods.intro_en: Extract basic statistics separately in each of two channels, compute one Euclidean distance per channel, then take their arithmetic mean. The displayed input concatenates channels only for visualization; the computation preserves channel boundaries and has no cross-channel dependence term.
methods.intro_zh: 分别从两个通道提取基础统计量，各自计算一个欧氏距离，再取算术平均。图中的输入仅为展示而按通道拼接；计算始终保留通道边界，不包含跨通道依赖项。
steps_en: Keep corresponding channel identities and units aligned.
Extract basic statistics independently from each channel.
Compute the Euclidean feature distance inside each channel.
Average the two channel distances with equal weights.
steps_zh: 保持对应通道身份与单位一致。
逐通道独立提取基础统计量。
分别计算每个通道内部的欧氏特征距离。
对两个通道距离等权平均。
animation_steps_en: Keep the two channel identities aligned; display them consecutively.
Extract mean, SD, minimum and maximum separately in each channel.
Compute one Euclidean feature distance per channel.
Average the two distances; cross-channel dependence is not measured.
caveats_en: Permuting observations leaves this vector unchanged, even when temporal behavior changes completely.
Features have different scales; this example uses no coordinate weighting. A production scaler must be fitted without test-data leakage.
A metric on these feature vectors can be only a pseudometric on the original series when the representation loses information.
Averaging independent channel distances cannot detect cross-channel timing or dependence changes that preserve each marginal descriptor.
caveats_zh: 任意重排序列不会改变该向量，即使时间行为发生显著变化。
各坐标尺度不同；本例不加权。实际使用的缩放器应避免测试数据泄漏。
当表示损失信息时，特征空间中的度量在原序列空间上可能只是伪度量。
独立通道距离的平均无法识别保持各通道边缘描述不变的跨通道时序或依赖变化。

steps_en: Keep corresponding channel identities and units aligned.

Compute the Euclidean feature distance inside each channel.

steps_zh: 保持对应通道身份与单位一致。

animation_steps_en: Keep the two channel identities aligned; display them consecutively.
Extract four consecutive block means separately in each channel.
Compute one Euclidean PAA-vector distance per channel.
Average the two distances; cross-channel dependence is not measured.
caveats_en: The displayed Euclidean feature distance is unscaled; the usual length-scaled PAA lower bound additionally multiplies it by sqrt(n/w).
Short events within a block can cancel, and moving a block boundary can alter the representation.
A metric on these feature vectors can be only a pseudometric on the original series when the representation loses information.
Averaging independent channel distances cannot detect cross-channel timing or dependence changes that preserve each marginal descriptor.
caveats_zh: 图中欧氏特征距离未经长度缩放；常用 PAA 下界还需乘以 sqrt(n/w)。
区间内的短暂事件可能互相抵消，改变分段边界也会改变表示。
当表示损失信息时，特征空间中的度量在原序列空间上可能只是伪度量。
独立通道距离的平均无法识别保持各通道边缘描述不变的跨通道时序或依赖变化。
